commitResults.messageTitle: Add role field support to person model and command flow
commitResults.messageBody:
This commit introduces the first integration of the Role field into the contact model and command layer. It allows contacts to have an associated role that is parsed from user input and displayed before the contact name.

Changes made:
- Introduced Role.java as a new value object with validation rules
- Updated Person.java to include a Role field and getter
- Added r/ prefix in CliSyntax.java to represent role input
- Added role parsing support in ParserUtil.java
- Updated AddCommandParser.java to require a role when adding a contact
- Updated EditCommandParser.java and EditCommand.java to allow editing roles
- Updated AddCommand.java and EditCommand.java usage messages to include the role field
- Updated Messages.format(Person) to display role before name

Remaining work for full feature integration (to be completed by Quang):
- Update JsonAdaptedPerson.java to serialize and deserialize the Role field
- Update storage tests such as JsonAdaptedPersonTest.java
- Update test utilities including PersonBuilder, TypicalPersons, and CommandTestUtil
- Update JSON test data files to include the new role attribute
- Update UI components (e.g. PersonCard) if role should be displayed in the contact list
- Ensure all affected tests pass after integrating the role field across storage and test layers

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor confirmation flow for add and delete commands
commitResults.messageBody:
This PR gives the full functionality increment of the confirmation flow refactor for add/delete commands.

Changes made:
- Generalized `ConfirmDeleteCommand` and `ConfirmAddCommand` with the new abstract `ConfirmCommand`.
- Refactored the confirmation workflow so confirmation commands are executed first, before the real command is executed later upon `y`.
- Updated parser and logic handling where appropriate to support confirmation-based command execution.
- Updated `AddCommand` and related model classes where needed to support confirmed duplicate-add behavior.
- Added and adjusted test suites for confirmation flow and duplicate-add handling for successful CI.

Reviewers to check:
- [ ] Confirmation prompt appears correctly for delete and duplicate-add flows
- [ ] `y/n` confirmation behaves as expected and does not cause unexpected parse errors
- [ ] Confirmed duplicate add works correctly without breaking existing add behavior
- [ ] Code edit does not break abstraction
- [ ] The PR is sent from a fork, and is from a separate branch
- [ ] Commit messages comply with the [Git Conventions](https://nus-cs2103-ay2526-s2.github.io/website/admin/standardsAndConventions.html)

Changes made:
- Delete and modify the code segment that handles duplicate person exception during data loading phase (after opening the app).
- (minor changes) Modify the logic of the weak comparison method "isSamePerson".
  Before: need Role and Name to be the same
  Now: only need Name to be the same
  Rationale: a person can have multiple different roles
- Modify tests accordingly.

Changes made:
- Add necessary details about changes made so far to relevant documentations (DeveloperGuide.md, UserGuide.md, ReleaseNoteV1-3.md)

- Continue fixing the "duplicate load upon open app" bug (that persists due to inadequate testing). Ensure that the app runs correctly this time.
- Change ConfirmCommand type from abstract class to interface (to allow inheritance of ConfirmXXXCommand from XXXCommand)
- Add further details about changes made so far to relevant documentations (DeveloperGuide.md,  ReleaseNoteV1-3.md)

Changes made:

- Modify unit tests to adapt with new intended behaviors for `resetData` and `setPerson(s)`.
- Prune unused import statements.
[New Feature] Implement busy command to track contact unavailability

commitResults.messageTitle: Add run-all-checks.sh to automate all checks
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a bash script to run all `check-* `scripts and Gradle tasks
in a single command.

The script was searching for check-* scripts in the wrong
directory, causing repository checks (e.g. EOF newline)
to be skipped. Updated the path to ensure all checks are
executed correctly.
